content: The minimum SIP amount for HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan is ₹100.
An exit load of 1% applies if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year from the date of allotment. No exit load applies after 1 year.
The benchmark for HDFC Large Cap Fund is NIFTY 100 Total Return Index.
HDFC Large Cap Fund is classified as Very High risk on the Riskometer.
HDFC Large Cap Fund does not have a lock-in period.
The Total Expense Ratio shown for HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan is 1.03%.
